description: r2:F1 (11e Waaagh! = riled up, no 10e melee bonus). Orks' Command phase at 11e: the Waaagh! panel describes the 11e army rule (5+ invulnerable save, ranged [ASSAULT], advancing does not prevent charging) and never '+1 Strength / +1 Attack'. A real click on CALL DA WAAAGH! makes the Ork units riled up: waaagh_active, 5+ invuln, advance-and-charge AND ranged [ASSAULT] (effect_advance_and_shoot) — and the game log line names the 11e benefits. The engine's 10e +1 A / +1 S gate (FactionAbilityManager.waaagh_melee_bonus_applies) is false for a riled-up unit, and the same-seed melee A/B for the riled-up Deff Dread (Dread Klaws vs the engaged Prosecutors) rolls the same number of hit dice at the same Strength as without the Waaagh!.

steps.comment: the 10e +1 A / +1 S gate is closed at 11e
same seed A/B: riled-up Deff Dread melee = plain Deff Dread melee (no +1 A / +1 S)
the game log names the 11e benefits
